name: wvtt

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: tsx server/test/hiddenInfo.ts && tsx server/test/scripting.ts && tsx server/test/minimalPack.ts && tsx server/test/chessRules.ts && tsx server/test/enforcement.ts && tsx server/test/eightsRules.ts && tsx server/test/newPacks.ts && tsx server/test/stacking.ts && tsx server/test/clock.ts && tsx server/test/security.ts && tsx server/test/persistence.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:prod

description: WVTT — Web Virtual Table Top. Browser multiplayer 3D sandbox tabletop with scriptable, shareable game packs.
